title: 2019 AMC 12B Problem 11
statement: How many unordered pairs of edges of a given cube determine a plane?

solutions.text:
Two edges determine a plane exactly when they are coplanar, that is, parallel or intersecting.

The \(12\) edges split into \(3\) directions of \(4\) parallel edges, giving \(3\binom{4}{2}=18\) parallel pairs. Edges sharing a vertex give \(8\binom{3}{2}=24\) intersecting pairs.

The total is \(18+24=42.\)

Thus, D is the correct answer.
